title: which mechanism carries the DRAM pattern effect: pins driven high after read DBI, pin toggles, and the channels' line changes
question: the part of the kinds page's section 11 item 12 that asks which mechanism carries E81's DRAM pattern effect
registered_by: a3-e99-dram (Q132), on the Intel; no card opened for this file
command: E75's and E81's DRAM command unchanged: enercat_host --pattern flw_pat --harts 1 --seconds 4 --window 240000000 --operands <op> --stride 64 --slice-bytes 131072 --region 131072
binary: build/enercat-e99/host/enercat_host: E81's main.cpp with one added operand (make_host_src.py), linked as enercat-hl was, launching enercat-hl's kernel ELF unchanged

decision.headline_passes: 9911 onward (the warm-up 9910 is reduced and reported, never in the headline)
decision.pass_gates: E81's: anchor_pi first-to-last drift above 0.3 W sets a pass aside; so does a pass in which more than a third of its DRAM runs fail a run gate
decision.run_gates: E81's: one clock; voltage within 3 mV of the pass median; an on-protocol launch within 0.5 C of 58 C after a 59 C preheat; window median took_ms <= 60 ms; an ok device record
decision.estimator: E81's: per kept pass each item's leakage-corrected board power p80 over [t0+1 s, t0+3 s); every contrast a within-pass difference; the mean over headline passes with a two-sided t interval on their scatter (df = n - 1); W to pJ per 64 B line with the measured line rate
decision.primary_arm: dips removed: dp/posthoc_dips.py's definition (E82 A2's), board_w[i] < min(board_w[i-2], board_w[i+2]) - 4 W, registered here before any data; the unfiltered arm is reported beside it, and any verdict that differs between the two is named
decision.leak: E81's auto (median within-run slope); 0.2936 and 0.3803 W/C reported as sensitivities
decision.classes: E81's: PRESENT when the mean is >= 0.25 W and the 95 % interval excludes 0; ABSENT when the 95 % interval lies inside +-0.30 W; otherwise UNRESOLVED
decision.budget: at most 33 card-minutes in all: a smoke of about 2 min, then up to six passes of about 5 min; no pass starts once the session's card clock has passed 27 min, or after 01:50 PDT (the next lane on this card), by touching build/mf-STOP; a pass that has started finishes. Fewer than three headline passes: every verdict UNRESOLVED
decision.order: runitems.py's: anchor_pi first and last, the DRAM items shuffled per pass by Random('aifoundry3|<pass>|<pass>')
